subject: Data lockdown: finalize amounts, SKUs, next steps for Oct close
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Data lockdown: finalize amounts, SKUs, next steps for Oct close

Team —

Finance asked for a final, certified snapshot of all October-close opportunities for Orchid Analytics (ORCH-4582) by COB Monday. We need the following validated in CRM for each active opp:

- Amount (USD) — confirm ARR vs one-time, currency conversions applied
- Product / SKU line items — match pricing matrix and SKU codes
- Next step + owner (brief one-liner)
- Probability and expected close date (no estimates: actual committed dates only)

I pulled the current extract and attached a small CSV with the rows I think matter (orchid-oppty-extract-20261003.csv). There are ~18 items flagged as "commit" in the forecast but several have missing SKU or unclear next step.

Please do the following:
- Ben: update line-item SKUs and mark any missing pricing references.
- Marissa: validate amounts and indicate ARR vs one-time in the Amount Description column.
- Lauren: confirm next-step phrasing and set the single owner for each opp.

If anything is blocked (procurement, custom pricing, legal redlines), mark it in the Status column and tag me and Grace. We need firm answers so Finance can finalize the close.

Deadline: COB Monday, 10/05 (we'll do a quick sweep Monday afternoon).

Thanks —
Priyom
--
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: orchid-oppty-extract-20261003.csv (CSV, 18 rows)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data lockdown: finalize amounts, SKUs, next steps for Oct close

Got it — thanks Priyom. I'm assigning owners in the extract and will standardize the next-step language to the "Sales — Contract sent / Awaiting signature / Procurement PO" set so Finance gets consistent phrasing.

Ben: can you take the SKU mapping and push changes to the CSV by EOD tomorrow? Marissa: can you run a quick audit on any opportunities with amount > $50k? Flag anything that looks like a bundle/one-time vs ARR.

If anything requires legal or pricing manager review, cc me and I'll escalate.

-Lauren
--
Lauren Bishop
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

> Got it — thanks Priyom. I'm assigning owners in the extract and will standardize the next-step language...

Quick update from my side — I ran SKU mapping against the pricing matrix and made the following changes (attached oppty-updates-20261004.csv):

- ORCH-4582-01 (Priyom): matched to SKU R-INF-ENT-24, updated amount to $120,000 ARR (was blank SKU).
- ORCH-4582-04 (Priyom): bundle identified; split lines into R-INF-ENT-24 + R-INF-SUPPORT, adjusted amount and set amount type = "ARR + One-time".
- ORCH-4582-11: Pricing discrepancy flagged — contact pricing@redwoodinference.com if we need an exception.

Also adjusted probability for ORCH-4582-04 down to 40% (customer still finalizing internal approvals) and set Status = "At-risk — pending procurement". Everything else I updated with SKU codes and normalized descriptions.

Attachment: oppty-updates-20261004.csv (CSV, 12 updated rows)

Ben

Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data lockdown: finalize amounts, SKUs, next steps for Oct close

Thanks for the heads-up team. We've reviewed the updated SKU mapping Ben sent. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We will sign the remaining addendum but need the official PO issued to our procurement contact. Expect PO by Oct 18; can you update Close Date to 2026-10-20 for the affected line items?
- Confirmed SKUs R-INF-ENT-24 and R-INF-SUPPORT are correct.
- For ORCH-4582-04, probability is 40% on our side until procurement returns the PO.

If you can reflect the revised close date and attach the final quote with SKU lines, that will unblock finance for our internal approvals.

Best,
